latestVersion.changelog: Add bounded REST/WebSocket readers, registry/Assist/Energy/repair discovery, validation and target queries; correct API examples; document MCP and direct routes; protect credentials and clarify privacy and action effects. 60 tests and Windows/Linux CI.

raw_record.summary: Inspect and control Home Assistant using REST and supported WebSocket workflows. Discover capabilities, action schemas, device/entity registries, Assist, automations, calendars, energy statistics and diagnostics. Use when the user asks to inspect, troubleshoot or operate an existing Home Assistant installation; not for general smart-home product advice or unrelated device questions.
